name: Okashiya-san ni Nerawareta!
original_name: 犯し屋さんに狙われた!
source: I was introduced to a peculiarly secure membership-based adult site called "Your Town's Violator" by an online friend. On this site, girls are referred to by serial numbers and candy names, with no real names revealed. It features unrealistically extreme content and men who act solely to fulfill their desires. It seems a bit contrived, but it serves its purpose as adult entertainment. The site claims that the girls captured as "merchandise" are appropriately targeted and undergo real sexual training before being provided to members. It's quite elaborate, haha. That's what I thought... until that moment... when I saw a girl who I encountered while part-working at the convenience store. She was dressed in bondage fashion, with a collar and blindfold, crying while being forcibly violated by a man. The title was "Blindfolded Convenience Store Fuck Session!". I played the video that was updated today, and my knees trembled... I saw myself in it... so, this site is not staged, is that it? Ai... my precious sister... has become a target of these violators!!!
